description: Harden the A11 detection recipe: text-mode grep for NUL/invalid-UTF-8 documents, space-containing path claims, and distinct missing/non-regular/unreadable document messages, with S4 contract cases
deviation_notes: All 9 top-level tasks are done and the 3 phase checkpoints are recorded, with a push after each phase. (1) The command-word skip list was dropped: the anchored path pattern already excludes a space before the first slash, so the list was unreachable; the spec now says so and a trailing-characters case pins the ^...$ anchors. (2) The S4 sensitivity mutants were retargeted to the new recipe lines and four were added (text mode, space pattern, document branches). (3) The symlink-to-/dev/zero and FIFO rows stay report-only (latency), as the spec states.
